children: Kalshi and the CFTC punished White House teleprompter operator Gabriel Perez after he bet on Trump’s speech text before the president read it aloud. Perez must give up $107,539.02 in profit, pay a $65,000 fine and is barred from trading for three years, according to BeInCrypto, with the CFTC saying the penalty was discounted because of his exemplary cooperation. Kalshi enforcement head Robert DeNault said users who violate rules or federal law will face consequences.

title: Kalshi Warns Users After CFTC Punishes White House Teleprompter Operator
